expectations.text: Names the requirement for a publicly hosted privacy policy AND a separate support page
expectations.evidence: "**Privacy policy URL** — mandatory for every app, no exceptions." and separately "**Support URL** — required. A simple page with an email address is enough."

expectations.text: Names the working test sign-in account required for the human App Store reviewer to get past the login screen
expectations.evidence: "**A demo account in the App Review Notes.** If there's a login wall, the reviewer needs working credentials. Put a real, working email and password in the notes field — not a placeholder — and verify it logs in right before you submit."
"**App icon** — 1024×1024, no alpha channel, no transparency, no pre-rounded corners. Alpha channel in the icon is an automatic upload failure."

expectations.text: Names the screenshot requirements including the 6.5 inch iPhone display and iPad
expectations.evidence: It names a different iPhone size: "**Screenshots** — at minimum the 6.9" iPhone set. If you don't want iPad, set the app to iPhone-only in the target settings; otherwise you need iPad screenshots". iPad is covered, but the 6.5 inch iPhone display the assertion asks for is never mentioned.

expectations.text: States that a pricing schedule must be selected even if the app is free
expectations.evidence: No pricing schedule requirement appears. The money section covers only IAP rules and ends "If it's free for now, skip all of that — but note that adding IAP later means another review." — the opposite framing, and the App Store Connect checklist omits pricing entirely.

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-launch security audit, ideally two passes run from a cleared/fresh context
expectations.evidence: No audit is recommended. Security appears only as two ad-hoc manual checks — "check that RLS is enabled on every table... Go through the table list in the Supabase dashboard one by one" and the API key question. There is no structured pre-launch security audit, and no mention of two passes or a cleared/fresh context.

expectations.text: Recommends TestFlight beta distribution to real testers before public launch
expectations.evidence: TestFlight is named only as a self-testing channel for the release build: "Do an `eas build --profile production`, push it to TestFlight, install *that* on your phone, and run through the whole app fresh." Beta distribution to real testers before launch is never recommended.

expectations.text: Flags protecting the Claude API key and rate-limiting the vision endpoint, since an exposed or unbounded paid endpoint is both a security and cost exposure
expectations.evidence: "**Is your Anthropic API key in the app bundle?**... that key is extractable... The fix is a Supabase Edge Function that holds the key server-side... While you're in there, add per-user rate limiting — a cap on analyses per day — because otherwise one enthusiastic user or one scraper is your whole month's budget."
